resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Register says a camp was set up in 1924. The May 1924 newspaper item and WillhiteWeb say the cabin and tower were built in fall 1923. The story follows the 1923 date and reports the Register's 1924 camp.
The Register and WillhiteWeb say the tower was removed in 1952. Fire Lookout says destroyed. The story reports removal and notes the disagreement only through the source citations.

notes_for_editor: The 1923 versus 1924 start date conflicts; the story reports both. No source describes the site today beyond 2012 and undated photo credits, so no access or visit keys. height_m 13.7 is converted from the 45-foot tower height. The brief's elevation (1548.4 m) matches the Register's 5,080 ft. The 1934 panoramic date (9-28-1934) comes from the Register caption. The spelling Jack Knife appears in the 1920s newspaper items and Jackknife elsewhere; the story uses Jackknife Mountain as in the brief.
